title: Gloomhaven, but a noir thriller in war-weary Finland
author: Unfair_Ordinary_4436
selftext:
This is Sisu & Survival: A Story of the Place We Call Finland, a story-driven survival RPG with tactical hex-based split card combat.

I have been writing this story for over a year and my original plan was to make a board game out of it. However, after I saw how much Claude has recently developed, I decided to try to make a video game out of it and was surprised with the results. Story and mechanics are my own writing, but Claude helps me to write the code and create the scenes. Obviously development still requires a lot of effort but it is proceeding nicely.

Some things I am currently fixing:  
\- enemies look like standing in between the hexes  
\- spotlight effect on the hex board makes it hard to see some hexes  
\- health bars look unprofessional  
\- I already have a tutorial but I am making it more intuitive based on feedback I got from my wife
